name: gnomon-cpu-product-v1
evidence: GIFT-Eval-derived online evaluation; not the official leaderboard protocol
fallback: seasonal_naive; record every model failure and timeout
primary_metric: MASE, equal weights per series within configuration and per configuration overall
bootstrap_block: max(ceil(horizon/stride), ceil(score_origins/4)); all series resampled together
foundation_models: Deferred from this CPU-first pool; no pretrained-model or full-FASE reproduction claim
